title: Deployment of Gnosis Safe multisig and subsequent support service
body:
**Following the template and guide:**
[**https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/1132-edgeware-proposal-process-and-template**](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/1132-edgeware-proposal-process-and-template)

**1. Date of proposal**
**06/09/22**
** **
**2. Author/s of proposal**
**Name: Rafael Cesar**
**a. Contact details:  rafael@protofire.io**
**b. Telegram: @rafaelccg ; Discord: Rafael | Protofire#6261**
** **
**3. Proposal summary**
**The proposal can also be found at: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SUfAjMEWfs3Xqu8O6SyhbFrTVASANW4Z/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102484339150103204331&rtpof=true&sd=true](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SUfAjMEWfs3Xqu8O6SyhbFrTVASANW4Z/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102484339150103204331&rtpof=true&sd=true)**
** **
**We propose to deploy Gnosis Safe multisig ([https://gnosis-safe.io/app/](https://gnosis-safe.io/app/)) on your network, so that we can help you expand your ecosystem, and possibly even turn this into a long-term collaboration. There had been more than U$100 billion locked in Safes a few months ago. Even Vitalik Buterin keeps his assets in Safes due to the quality of the technology. We have collaborated with Gnosis Safe to develop the first version of the Gnosis Safe app itself, and since then we have been helping them to launch it on several respected networks, such as Moonbeam ([https://multisig.moonbeam.network/](https://multisig.moonbeam.network/)), Evmos ([https://safe.evmos.org/welcome](https://safe.evmos.org/welcome)), Astar ([https://staging-safe.astar.network/](https://staging-safe.astar.network/)), Velas, Acala, Cronos, among others that are on the way. Protofire has been a long-time partner of several Gnosis projects throughout the years, both on Gnosis Safe, as well as developing solutions for the Gnosis Protocol – such as the Conditional Tokens Framework ([https://cte.gnosis.io/](https://cte.gnosis.io/)) -, as well as collaborating on the Cowswap DEX ([https://cowswap.exchange/](https://cowswap.exchange/)) and the CoW Prot
